An Early-Medieval silver sceat of Primary Series C, c.700-710.Abramson (2012. 51) No. 4.10. var. retrograde inscription? Description: Obverse: Radiate bust right, crescent ear. annulet either side of broken A, pellets behind low pyramidal beaded neck on linear and beaded exergual line. Legend: 'Tᚨᛈᚨ' , AEPA inscription, letters retrograde. Reverse: Beaded votive with downwards sloping horns…
